metric.meaning: Relative share of human-authored textual line churn attributed to one canonical author email in one eligible Git release window.
metric.claim_boundary: A contribution/ownership evidence signal; not a complete or universal measure of developer quality, maintainability, trustworthiness, or reputation.

window_policy.ancestry_requirement: FROM_COMMIT must be an ancestor of TO_COMMIT
window_policy.short_window_action: allow, retain duration classification as contextual evidence

extraction_policy.path_scope: all paths reported by git numstat; no source-language or directory filter
extraction_policy.text_line_accounting: numeric added and deleted numstat fields
extraction_policy.binary_accounting: a dash in either numstat count marks one binary-file change and contributes zero added, deleted, and churn lines

population_policy.bot_action: exclude identity row from numerator candidates and denominator
population_policy.known_limitation: The regex is a frozen heuristic and can produce false positives or false negatives.

identity_policy.aggregation_scope: all non-merge commits with the canonical email inside one project window
identity_policy.display_name_selection: most frequent non-unknown author name for the canonical email in the window; lexical tie-break
identity_policy.developer_id_hash_input: UTF-8 bytes of domain separator m4-developer-id-v1 followed by one NUL byte and the canonical email
identity_policy.privacy_note: This is pseudonymization, not anonymization; an unsalted email hash may be vulnerable to guessing.

calculation_policy.numerator: sum of added_text_lines + deleted_text_lines for the selected human canonical identity in the eligible window
calculation_policy.denominator: sum of added_text_lines + deleted_text_lines over all human canonical identities in the same eligible window
calculation_policy.sum_note: Independently rounded developer ppm values are not required to sum to exactly 1000000.

supporting_window_signals.top1_share_churn: maximum exact developer churn share in the window
supporting_window_signals.gini_churn: Gini coefficient over nonnegative human developer churn values using the frozen Phase I formula
supporting_window_signals.ledger_role: context and analysis support; not the primary per-developer ledger value

hash_policy.canonical_json_profile: UTF-8 JSON, object keys sorted lexicographically, no insignificant whitespace, no NaN or Infinity; all hashed numeric metric fields represented as integers
hash_policy.analysis_policy_hash: SHA-256 of the canonicalized complete policy JSON
hash_policy.evidence_hash: SHA-256 of the later versioned canonical evidence manifest

required_conditions: developer and window arithmetic validations pass
frozen Phase I ownership cross-check passes
